auth.title: Caregiver Access
auth.hint: Enter the PIN to access system settings.
auth.pinError: Incorrect PIN. Please check with the responsible caregiver.

voice.title: Personalized voice
voice.description: Recreate the patient's voice from a recording (voice note, video, old audio). Everything is processed and stored on this computer.
voice.lgpd: LGPD/GDPR: voice is sensitive biometric data. The reference audio, the model and the generated phrases stay exclusively on this computer, for the patient's assistive use, and can be deleted at any time.

intro.tagline: Your voice begins with your gaze.

login.title: Sign in to your account
login.subtitle: Use the same email and password as on the website.
login.createAccount: No account yet? Create one on the website

errors.no-subscription: This account has no active subscription.
errors.device-limit: Your subscription is already active on another computer.
errors.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.

login.devMode: Developer Mode (open the menu without calibrating)

activated.title: You're all set
activated.boundHere: This computer has been linked to your account.

transfer.title: Move activation to this computer
transfer.explain: Your plan allows {{limit}} computer at a time. Activating here will disconnect the device below.

blocked.title: We couldn't validate your licence
blocked.revoked: Your subscription is no longer active.
blocked.device-unbound: This licence is linked to another computer.
blocked.grace-expired: The app has been offline for too long. Connect once to keep using it.

consent.title: Privacy
consent.lead: Before you add the patient, here is what happens to the data.
consent.localBody: Camera images, gaze calibration and patient details never leave this machine. No video is uploaded.
consent.remoteBody: Only your sign-in: email, password and the check that your subscription is active.
consent.checkbox: I have read and agree to the data handling described above.

profiles.title: Who will be using IrisFlow Communicator?
profiles.subtitle: Each patient has their own calibration and vocabulary.
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Create the first one.

form.title: New patient
form.name: Name
form.photoHint: The photo stays on this computer only.

permissao.title: IrisFlow Communicator needs your camera
permissao.why: The camera is what lets the patient control the computer with their eyes. It stays on while the app is in use.
permissao.privacy: The image never leaves this computer. Nothing is recorded or uploaded — video is processed here and discarded frame by frame.
permissao.patient: The patient doesn't need to do anything yet. This setup is for you.
permissao.deniedBody: This permission belongs to the system, not to IrisFlow Communicator. Open Windows Settings at the path below, turn camera access on, and come back.

camera.title: Which camera to use
camera.lead: If there is more than one, pick the one facing the patient.
camera.none: No camera found. Connect a webcam and try again.
camera.fpsBoa: Good rate. Tracking runs as designed.
camera.fpsBaixa: Low rate. It will work, with slightly worse accuracy — the system is tuned for 30 frames per second.
camera.fpsRuim: Very low rate. Usable, but gaze will respond slowly. A better webcam would fix this.
camera.neverBlocks: This is a warning, not a blocker: you can continue with any camera.

posicionamento.title: Patient position
posicionamento.lead: Get this right before calibrating. What you fix now you won't fix at every session.
posicionamento.screenHeightHint: Top of the screen at eye level, or slightly below. The camera can't measure this — it's yours to check.
posicionamento.holdBody: The button unlocks after {{segundos}} seconds with everything green.
posicionamento.lost: Position lost. The count starts over.

iluminacao.title: Room lighting
iluminacao.lead: The right light is worth more than an expensive webcam.
iluminacao.luxWhy: If you have a lux meter (phone apps work), note it here. The automatic check measures eye brightness after the webcam's auto-exposure, so it will pass even a dark room — only a measured value makes this session comparable to another.
iluminacao.luxSkip: No meter? Leave it blank and carry on.

monitor.title: Monitor size
monitor.lead: This number is what converts pixels into degrees in the accuracy report.
monitor.noEdid: The system did not report this monitor's size.
monitor.noEdidWhy: Without the real value, the report's angular error becomes an estimate. Measure the diagonal of the image area — corner to corner, excluding the bezel.

atalho.title: Environment setup
atalho.never: Not done yet for this patient.
atalho.why: Redo it when you change rooms, swap the webcam or move the monitor — the old setup describes an environment that no longer exists.

dwell.label: Dwell time
dwell.hint: How long the gaze must rest on something before it becomes a click.

faixa.cumprida: Mission done. Go back to the tutorial whenever you want.

semCalibracao.texto: Your gaze has not been calibrated yet, so looking at targets will not click. Calibrate first to do the tutorial with your eyes.

dwell.title: Look to click
dwell.lead: There is no button to press. You look at something and it gets chosen on its own.
dwell.passo1: You look at what you want.
dwell.passo2: A ring starts filling around it.
dwell.passo3: When the ring closes, it is chosen.
dwell.tempo: Right now the ring takes {{s}} seconds to close.
dwell.estatico: Animation off: the three stages are above, in order.

pratica.title: Try it. Look at the blue circle.
pratica.lead: Hold your gaze until the ring closes. There is no mistake here, and no time limit.
pratica.fim: Done. That is what it should feel like.
pratica.rapido: The click came before your gaze settled. Want a longer time?
pratica.lento: You held longer than needed. You could shorten the time.
pratica.bom: Good. That is how it should feel.

ajuste.title: The right time is yours
ajuste.lead: More time avoids clicks you did not mean. Less time is less tiring. Try it on the target beside.

emergencia.title: The emergency button
emergencia.lead: It sits in the corner of the screen, everywhere in the app.
emergencia.como: Triggering it needs a longer look than a normal click, and still asks for confirmation — so it does not fire by accident.
emergencia.ensaioAtivo: Drill on: nothing will be sent. Look at the red button.
emergencia.ensaiado: That is what will happen. Next time, the call for help is sent for real.

concluido.title: All set
concluido.lead: You know enough to get started.
concluido.refazer: You can redo this tutorial any time, in Settings.

atalho.title: Usage tutorial
atalho.never: Not done yet for this patient.
atalho.semEnsaio: The emergency drill was not run.
atalho.why: Redo it when the dwell time stops fitting — with ALS that changes over time.

comunicacao.title: Say something
comunicacao.lead: Ready-made phrases are the shortest path from looking to being understood. You pick one and the computer speaks for you.
comunicacao.ir: Open quick phrases and speak one
comunicacao.feito: You just spoke using your eyes.
comunicacao.missao: Tutorial: pick a phrase and hear the computer say it.

digitacao.title: Write a sentence of your own
digitacao.lead: Ready-made phrases are fast, but they don't say everything. On the keyboard you write whatever you want: pick a group of letters, then the letter. Write anything — one word is enough — and press Speak.
digitacao.feito: You wrote and spoke a sentence of your own. This is what the app exists for.
digitacao.travado: This is the one step that waits for you: write a sentence on the keyboard and come back. If you'd rather not, "Skip the tutorial" is still there.
digitacao.missao: Tutorial: write any word and press Speak.

conversa.title: Answer someone
conversa.lead: In conversation you answer yes, no, or a short phrase — without writing everything again for each question.
conversa.feito: Answered. That's how a conversation keeps moving.
conversa.missao: Tutorial: answer something — yes, no, or one of the phrases.

lazer.title: And you can play, too
lazer.lead: The games aren't decoration: they're the least tiring way to train your gaze, and they were what patients liked most in testing.
lazer.ir: Open the games and try one
lazer.feito: Done. The games stay in the menu, whenever you want them.
lazer.missao: Tutorial: open one of the games.

recursos.title: What else is here
recursos.lead: You don't have to visit everything now. Just know it's in the menu when you need it.

fotos.texto: see your photos and draw with your eyes.

descanso.texto: a calm screen, nothing asking for attention.

noticias.texto: read the day without needing anyone.

cuidador.texto: guide and settings for whoever supports you.

recursos.ajustes: Settings is deliberately outside this tutorial: it's where you change what makes gaze work, and a wrong choice there ruins the calibration. Whoever supports the patient finds everything under Settings, including redoing this tutorial.

preparo.title: Before we start
preparo.lead: Calibration teaches the system to read your gaze. It is {{alvos}} points and takes about {{min}} minute.
preparo.i1: Look at the CENTRE of the target, not at its edge.
preparo.i2: Blink normally. Do not hold your blink — the eye dries out and the reading gets worse.
preparo.i3: Stay in the position you set during setup, and do not change it between points.
preparo.i4: If you need to stop, just leave. You can start again later.

resultado.title: Calibration result
resultado.bomBody: The system learned your gaze well. You can carry on.
resultado.aceitavelBody: Usable. Redoing may improve it, if you have the time.
resultado.refazerBody: The result came out below what is achievable.

motivo.sessaoRuim: The reading was unstable across the whole screen — usually light or distance.
motivo.alvoInaprendivel: One of the points was not learned, and that harms the others.
motivo.periferia: The screen corners came out less accurate than the centre.
motivo.erroAlto: Accuracy came out worse than expected, but evenly so.
motivo.derivaPostural: The head moved between points. Recalibrating without fixing the position repeats the result.

resultado.semObrigacao: Redoing is always optional — it is your call.

relatorio.title: Session report
relatorio.blocoUm: First run against this calibration. Comparing blocks needs a second one, without recalibrating.
relatorio.blocoAusente: No active calibration — this run belongs to no block.

conta.title: Account and subscription

estado.grace: Offline. The subscription still holds for a few days.
estado.blocked: The subscription is not valid right now.

conta.sairAviso: The patient loses access until someone signs in again. Calibration and profiles stay saved.

retomada.title: Checking
retomada.explica: This does NOT measure accuracy. It checks whether something changed since calibration — the position, the monitor, or who is in front of the camera.

corpo.seguir: Nothing changed since calibration. You can carry on.
corpo.atencao: The reading came out different from the previous check. You can use it as is, or calibrate again.
corpo.recalibrar: We could not confirm the calibration still holds.

motivo.posicaoRosto: Your face was not in frame.
motivo.posicaoDistancia: The distance to the screen is outside the range.
motivo.semMedicao: We could not measure the dots.
motivo.piorou: The reading came out well apart from this calibration's first check.

retomada.primeira: This was the first check for this calibration — it becomes the reference for the next ones.

historico.title: Accuracy history
historico.vazio: No measurements for this patient yet.
historico.poucos: Only one measurement. Progress shows from the second one.
historico.avisoHerdado: Measurements marked as inherited come from before the per-patient split, and may include another person's on this machine.

checksCamera.aviso: We could not confirm everything yet. You can continue anyway — if the cursor does not follow your gaze well, adjust the light or distance and calibrate again.

dicas.comunicacao: Look at a phrase and hold your gaze: it will be spoken aloud.
dicas.computador: Once enabled, the cursor leaves the app and follows your gaze across Windows. The side bar brings IrisFlow back.
dicas.pictogramas: Each picture speaks a need. Look and hold your gaze to speak it.
dicas.jogos: Games are gaze practice. No score, no timer — stop whenever you want.
dicas.conversa: Caregiver messages appear here. Look at one to hear it.

primeiroSucesso.title: You are ready.
primeiroSucesso.aviso: You just controlled IrisFlow using only your gaze.
